structure_rationale: Four asset groups clustered by product category rather than one campaign per brand. The account already contains ~30 abandoned single-brand PMax campaigns that never launched -- fragmenting budget that thinly is what stalled them. Clustering gives Google enough volume per asset group to actually exit the learning phase.
copy_sourcing_note: Every trust claim below is taken verbatim from BetterPatio's own live ad copy pulled from the account (Authorized Dealer, No Tax & Free Shipping, Speak To An Expert 24/7, trade accounts for contractors/designers/builders, commercial grade). No claims were invented -- asserting an unverified offer on a client account is a compliance risk, not just an accuracy one.

known_risk.issue: PMax optimizes toward a conversion signal. This account currently records zero purchase conversions -- the purchase pixel appears not to fire.
known_risk.consequence: Until tracking is confirmed, PMax has no signal to learn from and will spend budget discovering that. Trevor was advised of this and elected to proceed.
known_risk.mitigation: Launch paused. Confirm the purchase pixel fires before enabling. If tracking cannot be fixed first, consider running on MAXIMIZE_CLICKS temporarily so spend at least buys traffic rather than chasing a phantom signal.

images_required.warning: Do not substitute stock photography or AI-generated imagery. The ad standards are explicit that it reduces trust and CTR -- skip an asset rather than degrade it.
